mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workitem_comment (tenant_id, workitem_id, author_type, author_ref, content_md, gmt_create) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{workitemId}, #{authorType}, #{authorRef}, #{contentMd}, COALESCE(#{gmtCreate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workitem_comment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE workitem_comment SET author_ref = COALESCE(#{authorRef}, author_ref), content_md = COALESCE(#{contentMd}, content_md) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND author_type = 'EXTERNAL'
